name: scalekit-auth-stack
description: ARCHIVED. Install from scalekit-inc/authstack instead. Old five-plugin marketplace (agent-auth, full-stack-auth, mcp-auth, modular-sso, modular-scim).

plugins.name: mcp-auth
plugins.description: Guides users through adding production-ready OAuth 2.1 authorization to Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers

plugins.name: agent-auth
plugins.description: Implements Scalekit Agent Auth so AI agents can act in third-party apps (Gmail, Slack, Calendar, Notion) on behalf of users.

plugins.name: modular-sso
plugins.description: Integrates with all popular SSO providers (Okta, JumpCloud, Entra ID, etc.) and allows users to login to your app using their existing identity provider.

plugins.name: modular-scim
plugins.description: Automates user and group provisioning and deprovisioning via SCIM 2.0 with identity providers like Okta, Entra ID, and JumpCloud.

plugins.name: full-stack-auth
plugins.description: Adds end-to-end authentication to B2B and AI apps including user management, organization handling, session management, RBAC, and login flows.
